style: Premium TV-broadcast closing lockup. Deep navy night, warm orange ember glow, faint LED pixel grid and scanlines, drifting light motes. The logo assembles fast, the camp date punches in, then a red-orange rubber stamp slams KAYITLAR DOLDU. Confident and celebratory, never cartoonish.
font: Montserrat variable 100-900 (local woff2, latin + latin-ext by unicode-range)
block: none (hand-authored; reuses the tebrik-2026 kapanis-logo choreography)

catalog_searched: rubber stamp slam badge -> headline-slam (scale 1.6 -> 1 + deterministic three-frame stage shake), borrowed as the stamp landing idiom
LED pixel grid scanline background texture -> yt-lcd-background (repeating-gradient scanlines + pixel grid), borrowed as a CSS layer
light sweep shine across logo -> shimmer-sweep / logo-outro; adapted as an SVG alpha-masked gradient band so the sheen stays on the logo shapes
map pin icon location marker -> map blocks only (no standalone pin icon); hand-authored inline SVG pin
flash transition white flash in -> flash-through-white / editorial-flash-overlay (shader / transition blocks); a single decaying full-frame light layer is enough here
rules: motion-vocabulary: wave (letter rise), letter-spacing track-in + underline_sweep (label), scale_punch (date), clip-wipe rise (sub line), slide + drop (info line), slam + shake (stamp), hold_breath

stamp.ink: #E8432E plate, white type + inner rule, feTurbulence ink distress

timeline.what: warm-white flash decays from 0.9 to 0, covering the cut from the master
CAN'LI letters rise from their baseline windows, expo.out, 0.05 s stagger (C A N ’ L I)
#cap falls onto the A (lands 0.92), rebounds, settles 1.12; A micro-squash; tassel decaying swing
08 KASIM scale punch 0.55 -> overshoot -> 1 (back.out), blur to sharp, warm flare behind
’DA BAŞLIYOR rises out of a clip window
map pin drops with a bounce, info text slides in from the left
KAYITLAR DOLDU stamp slams: scale 1.6 -> 1, rotation -15 -> -8, shadow tightens
impact: three-frame stage shake, red ink ring + glow flash, ink specks burst
hold: glow drifts and breathes, motes drift, lockup push 1.00 -> 1.018
one diagonal light sweep across the logo (alpha-masked to the logo shapes)
